'''Wal of Power''' (Japanese: '''ピッピ・ウォールの大特訓''' ''{{tt|Pippi|Clefairy}} and {{tt|Wal's|Walnut's}} Super Crash Course'') is the 28th chapter of the [[Magical Pokémon Journey]] manga.

==Plot==
{{incomplete plot}}
Tired of being weak and picked on, {{TP|Hazel|Clefairy}} and [[Walnut]] team up to train in the art of ninjutsu under a master even [[Master Ditto]] looks up to... {{TP|Hazel|Jigglypuff}}!
